title: Cloud channel asset inventory and copy variants
body:
Purpose:
Draft, consolidate and prioritize the assets + copy variants we need to complete cloud marketplace listings and enable co-sell programs (AWS, Azure, GCP). This is a working inventory and a short copy playbook for partner ops and content owners.

Status notes (high level):
- This is a working single-source list for asset owners. Not all copy variants will be used; we will A/B across channels where allowed.
- Priority: Hosted API listing first (fastest time-to-availability), Dedicated next, Private (VPC/on-prem) last due to legal/PS requirements.

1) Minimal required assets (per channel) — quick checklist
- Logo: square + full lockup. Acceptable formats: SVG (preferred), PNG 3000x3000 (high-res).
- Banner image: 1200x300 (light and dark variants).
- 3 screenshots: console, dashboard, billing/usage view (1920x1080).
- Short description (1 line, 60–80 chars).
- Long description (300–800 chars).
- 6 feature bullets (15–30 chars each ideally).
- Pricing descriptor: free tier + paid tier summary (one-liner) and link to pricing page.
- Technical contact + sales lead emails.
- Legal docs: SOC2 report (redacted), DPA, sample MSA (or link to Partner Agreement), security whitepaper.
- Deployment options matrix (hosted / dedicated / private) in plain text.
- 1–2 customer logos and 1 short customer quote (25–40 words) with permission.

Channel-specific nuances (notes and requirements)
- AWS Marketplace:
  - Require AMI/Container or SaaS integration docs where applicable.
  - Pricing: can do SaaS metering; need billing integration stub and unit metrics defined.
  - AWS co-sell: must have a Qualified Solutions Architect sponsor + active listing in AWS Partner Central.
  - File size/format notes: use 1024x1024 PNG for marketplace tile if SVG fails.
  - Security: include certs and the compliance FAQ entry; SOC2 required for co-sell.

- Azure Marketplace:
  - Accepts commercial marketplace listing or managed app.
  - Requires MPN ID and publisher profile; certification flow can take longer (2–6 weeks).
  - Prepare ARM template or container spec if offering deployable image.
  - Legal: must provide indemnification language mapping; Azure legal team will request a redline of our MSA.

- Google Cloud Marketplace:
  - Supports SaaS, container, and VM-based images. For SaaS product, must provide endpoint, sample call flow, and OIDC integration doc.
  - Pricing: must provide SKUs; metering partners require clear usage metrics.
  - Customer data residency note: provide region hints, and guidance for private deployments.

2) Copy variants — short description (1-liners)
A. "Low-latency, cost-efficient LLM inference for production apps — hosted, dedicated, and private deployments."
B. "Predictable LLM inference: fast latency, lower unit cost, and enterprise controls for regulated data."
C. "Ship LLM features with a production-grade inference platform — multi-deployment and observability built-in."

Feedback: A is product-forward, B is GTM-enterprise-friendly, C is developer-focused. Use channel-specific POV when submitting (e.g., AWS: feature+SLA callout; GCP: developer + integration notes).

3) Long description (300–420 chars) — two versions
Version 1 (developer-focused):
"Redwood Inference provides a unified runtime for high-performance LLM inference across hosted APIs, reserved (dedicated) capacity, and private VPC/on-prem deployments. Reduce per-token cost with intelligent caching and batching, hit latency SLOs, and manage rollouts with first-class monitoring and model versioning."

Version 2 (enterprise security + ops):
"A production-first inference platform for teams that require predictable latency, cost controls, and enterprise-grade security. Choose hosted, dedicated, or private deployments with KMS/HSM integrations, audit logs, and SLA-backed capacity for regulated workloads."

4) Feature bullets (short) — pick 6, prioritize ordering for audience
- "High-throughput inference runtime"
- "Model versioning & canary rollouts"
- "Automatic batching & KV caching"
- "Dedicated GPU pools (reserved capacity)"
- "Private VPC and on-prem deployment options"
- "Per-token cost & latency analytics"

5) Pricing blurb examples (one-liners)
- "Free trial + pay-as-you-go hosted API; reserved capacity for predictable throughput. Contact sales for enterprise pricing."
- "Bring your own license or use our curated models — volume discounts available for committed Dedicated plans."

6) Asset details & owners (initial table as text)
- Logo SVG + PNG: owner = Design (Maya Thompson). Deadline: 2025-12-01.
- Banner and screenshots: owner = Product (Evan Liu). Deadline: 2025-12-08.
- Short + long copy, 3 variants: owner = GTM Content (Priya Shah). Deadline: 2025-11-15 (first draft).
- Pricing blurb & SKU mapping: owner = RevOps (Diego Ramirez). Deadline: 2025-12-15.
- Legal artifacts (SOC2, DPA): owner = Security & Legal (Samir Patel). Deadline: 2025-12-22.

7) Co-sell and GTM enablement checklist
- Confirm partner/program eligibility (AWS Partner Network, Azure MPN, Google Partner). Owner: GTM Ops.
- Acquire co-sell sponsor(s) and account mapping for first 3 named prospects.
- Create partner-facing sell sheet (1-pager) and a joint value proposition.
- Prepare a brief technical onboarding playbook for partner SA(s) (15–20 min read).
- Capture 2 use-case templates (search/chat/assistant + embedding pipeline) for marketplace listing demo.

8) Legal & security lift (quick wins)
- Provide a redacted SOC2 Type II and quick compliance FAQ (owner: Samir).
- Confirm KMS integrations and provide KMS compatibility statement for listing.
- Draft DPA + sample addendum for private deployments.

9) Example contractual language snippets (for partner legal) — draft only
- Data handling: "Customer data processed by Redwood Inference for hosted and dedicated deployments will not be used to train public models, and will be stored and processed per the customer's region and KMS settings."
- SLA: "Redwood will maintain 99.5% uptime for Dedicated customers; credits applied for monthly availability below target per the MSA."

10) Product / engineering constraints to call out in listing copy
- GPU-type availability: only select Dedicated SKUs support A100/4x A10x configurations — call out as "high-performance tiers" in spec sheet.
- Feature parity: not all hosted features are available in Private on initial rollout. Mark private as "feature-limited" in bullet until complete.

11) UX & screenshots guidance (do's and don'ts)
- Do: show real dashboard rows with mocked tokens redacted; prefer anonymized telemetry.
- Don't: surface internal customer emails or PII.
- Include a short caption under each screenshot describing the view and the user role (admin / developer / ops).

12) Timeline (high level)
- Week 0–1: finalize copy variants and asset ownership.
- Week 2–3: design assets and screenshots delivered.
- Week 4: internal legal signoff + upload to marketplaces for AWS/Azure/GCP staging.
- Week 5–6: partner ops coordinate co-sell enablement and test billing metering.

13) Open questions / risks
- Do we have permission to publish the chosen customer logos? (action: legal / CS outreach)
- Are we comfortable with the initial pricing descriptor (free trial vs free tier)? RevOps to decide.
- Will SOC2 redaction be acceptable for AWS co-sell? Check AWS co-sell checklist.

14) Next steps (owners assigned)
- Priya: lock short + long copy variants and send to Evan for screenshot guidance by 2025-11-15.
- Evan: produce banners + screenshot mockups by 2025-12-01.
- Diego: map pricing SKUs and define billing metric names by 2025-12-10.
- Samir: assemble redacted SOC2 + compliance FAQ and circulate to AWS AM by 2025-12-18.

Appendix: suggested naming conventions for assets (one-liners)
- logo_redwood_primary.svg, logo_redwood_inverse.png
- banner_marketplace_light_1200x300.png, banner_marketplace_dark_1200x300.png
- screenshot_console_01_1920x1080.png, screenshot_usage_02_1920x1080.png

Notes to reviewers: this doc is intentionally broad and channel-agnostic. If you are owning a single channel (AWS/Azure/GCP), annotate specific additional requirements inline and ping Priya. We'll collate channel-specific redlines and split into per-channel checklists once owners confirm.

-- end of draft --
